feed.title: Open U.S. federal prize competitions
feed.subtitle: Federal challenges listed on USA.gov and agency pages, by federal-prize-feed

entry.title: NASA Lunar Grounding Challenge ($150,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2027-01-15 Status: open Ways to safely and quickly discharge the static charge an astronaut's suit builds up during moonwalks at the lunar south pole, before touching the lander. Apply: https://work.crowdplat.com/challenge/lunar-grounding-challenge

entry.title: 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2026-11-15 Status: open NASA's global hackathon on November 14-15, 2026, open to anyone with an interest in space and science; registration is open now. Apply: https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/

entry.title: NASA TechLeap Prize: Orbital Clarity Challenge ($2,000,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2026-11-11 Status: open Low-cost ways to measure thermospheric density, pressure or drag in low Earth orbit. Phase 1 registration closes October 28, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET; Phase 1 submissions close November 11, 2026. Apply: https://occ.nasatechleap.org/

entry.title: NOURISH: Autoimmunity Digital Health Challenge ($650,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Institutes of Health Closes: 2027-01-08 20:00 ET Status: open Prototype digital tools (apps, wearables, AI systems) that help people with or at risk of autoimmune conditions track how food and nutrition affect their symptoms. Apply: https://nourishchallenge.org

entry.title: DARPA Surgical Competition ($3,500,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency Closes: 2027-03-26 16:00 ET Status: open Robotic systems that support surgeons and progressively take on complex trauma procedures autonomously. Apply: https://www.darpa.mil/research/challenges/surgical

entry.title: NASA's Human Lander Challenge (HuLC) ($126,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2027-03-04 23:59 ET Status: open University teams design communication systems for lunar landers and surface operations. Apply: https://hulc.nianet.org

entry.title: Documentation and Decision Support Sprint ($1,000,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency Closes: 2027-03-01 17:00 ET Status: open A virtual DARPA sprint for algorithms that document combat casualty care hands-free and support treatment decisions; DARPA's page says team qualification closes December 1, 2026. Apply: https://www.darpa.mil/research/challenges/d2

entry.title: Ready, Set...ID the Biothreat Challenge ($999,990)
entry.summary: Sponsor: U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Prize Competitions Closes: 2026-10-14 12:00 ET Status: open A three-stage DHS competition for AI-driven algorithms that spot known, new and unrecognized biological threats in environmental metagenomic data. Apply: https://www.dhs.gov/science-and-technology/ready-set-id-biothreat

entry.title: 2026-27 NASA TechRise Student Challenge ($1,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2026-11-02 23:59 ET Status: open Educator-led teams of U.S. students in grades 6-12 propose experiments that may fly on commercial suborbital vehicles. Apply: https://www.futureengineers.org/nasatechrise

entry.title: NASA's Gateways to Blue Skies (GBS) Competition ($72,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2027-02-23 23:59 ET Status: open College student teams propose airborne concepts for inspecting ground infrastructure by 2035. Apply: https://blueskies.nianet.org

entry.title: Careers in Your Community Challenge ($50,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: The U.S. Department of Education's Office of Career, Technical, and Adult Education Closes: 2026-11-19 18:00 ET Status: open High schools and their career and technical education students propose ways to help classmates discover local jobs and education options. Apply: https://careersinyourcommunity.ctemomentum.com

entry.title: ACL Cultivating Connected Communities Challenge ($600,000)

entry.title: xTech|Search 10 ($1,000,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: U.S. Army xTech Closes: 2026-10-19 17:00 ET Status: open Open-topic Army competition for eligible U.S. small businesses: three-page concept white papers first, then virtual pitches, a finals demo and Phase I SBIR/STTR proposals. Apply: https://xtech.army.mil/competition/xtechsearch10/

entry.title: One CDC Data Platform (1CDP) Innovation Challenge
entry.summary: Sponsor: Centers for Disease Control, Office of Public Health Data, Surveillance, and Technology Closes: 2026-10-28 18:00 ET Status: upcoming Pitches for reusable, shared functionality on CDC's unified public health data platform, for CDC and state, tribal, local and territorial partners. Apply: https://www.cdc.gov/data-modernization/php/one-cdc-data-platform/info-for-stlts-one-cdc-data-platform.html

entry.title: xTech|Kinetic Reach ($1,500,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: U.S. Army xTech Closes: 2026-11-30 23:59 ET Status: open Army competition for businesses of any size, worldwide, proposing agile sustainment technologies. Apply: https://xtech.army.mil/competition/xtechkinetic-reach/

entry.title: ACL Caregiver AI Prize Challenge ($2,500,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Administration for Community Living (ACL) Closes: 2029-02-06 17:00 ET Status: open AI-enabled tools for family caregivers and the direct care workforce; Phase 1 applications closed July 31, 2026, and Phase 1 winners are due in October 2026. Apply: https://acl.gov/caregiver-ai-competition

entry.title: Connecting Talent to Opportunity Challenge ($15,000,000)

entry.title: Halt the Hitchhiker: Invasive Species Challenge ($550,000)

entry.summary: Sponsor: National Institutes of Health (NIH) Closes: 2028-08-01 11:59 ET Status: open Human-based new approach methodologies (cell systems, computational models, assays) that can become usable research tools within three years. Apply: https://www.herox.com/Complement-ARIE-RTP
